decision_reason: The retained public-analysis application path stops at PublicAnalysisAdmissionHandoff. Vulnerability/risk evidence acquisition, Athena/knowledge retrieval, bounded synthesis, final result admission, end-to-end latency distribution, retry amplification, and response size are not composed into one executable public workload. Selecting a synchronous or asynchronous public topology before representative measurement would turn an architecture hypothesis into unsupported authority.

public_pipeline.notes: Strict JSON admission, exact GitHub URL projection, unknown-field rejection, no network call.
Fixed api.github.com host, no redirect following, no automatic adapter retry, immutable commit resolution, exact-commit uv.lock acquisition.
Only inert uv.lock is read and parsed; repository code is never executed.
Deterministic Phase 3/4 applicability and repository finding code exists but execute_instrumented_public_analysis does not call it.
Deterministic Risk Policy v1 exists outside the retained public handoff executor.
Bounded Athena executor exists, including polling, cancellation, result bounds, and data-scan evidence, but is not invoked by the public-analysis executor.
Bounded Bedrock Knowledge Base Retrieve and deterministic evidence admission exist, but are not invoked downstream of PublicAnalysisAdmissionHandoff.
Bounded Bedrock synthesis/agent baselines exist. PublicSemanticPlanner is an injected Protocol with no retained production implementation on main.
The retained public path returns PublicAnalysisAdmissionHandoff and stops. No public product response is admitted or persisted.
No public HTTP endpoint or public application compute is retained.

request.content_type: application/json hypothesis; transport not yet selected

repository.url_policy: https://github.com/{owner}/{repository} only; URL is projected to coordinates and is never reused as a fetch target
repository.reference_policy: requested_ref is optional; missing ref resolves the source-confirmed default branch; all downstream file evidence binds to an immutable resolved commit SHA

max_repository_files_read.note: The current public repository evidence path requests only uv.lock.

github_http_success_path_calls.derivation: get_repository=1; get_commit performs SHA resolution + exact commit fetch=2; get_uv_lock=1

github_http_automatic_retries.note: The retained GitHub HTTP adapter follows neither redirects nor automatic adapter retries.

athena_queries_per_public_analysis.note: Athena is retained and bounded, but no public-analysis composition currently proves how many structured queries the v1 workload requires.

retry_contract.rule: No public retry policy is authorized until duplicate-work and provider-SDK retry behavior are measured and bound.

idempotency_contract.rule: A mutable branch name cannot be the sole idempotency key; the resolved immutable repository snapshot must participate.

cancellation_contract.note: Athena has best-effort cancellation on its own polling timeout, but no public job-level cancellation contract exists.

aws_facts: HTTP API maximum integration timeout is 30 seconds and is not increaseable.
Lambda function timeout can be configured up to 900 seconds.
runtime_decision_matrix.fit: Only if representative end-to-end p95 remains comfortably below the transport timeout after upper-bound workload testing.
runtime_decision_matrix.tradeoffs: Small operational surface, but client lifetime and integration timeout couple directly to variable GitHub/Athena/Bedrock latency.

aws_facts: Regional REST API integration timeout defaults to a range ending at 29 seconds and can be increased, potentially requiring a reduction in the account-level throttle quota.
runtime_decision_matrix.fit: Possible for a measured bounded synchronous workload but not justified merely to stretch a long request across a synchronous transport.
runtime_decision_matrix.tradeoffs: More API-management capability than HTTP API, with no evidence yet that a longer synchronous hold is the right product contract.

aws_facts: SQS standard queues use at-least-once delivery semantics, so consumers must tolerate duplicate delivery.
runtime_decision_matrix.fit: Favored if representative public analysis has variable or >synchronous-envelope latency, requires backpressure, or benefits from independent failure isolation.
runtime_decision_matrix.tradeoffs: Adds queue, worker, persistence, idempotency, status/result lifecycle, cancellation semantics, IAM surfaces, and operational complexity.

aws_facts: Function URL auth types are AWS_IAM or NONE; NONE permits unauthenticated public invocation when the resource policy grants access.
Reserved concurrency can bound function concurrency and produce 429 throttling.
runtime_decision_matrix.fit: Technically small, but it does not by itself establish the complete public abuse/quota/product boundary OpsLens needs.
runtime_decision_matrix.tradeoffs: Lower ingress surface complexity, weaker fit for explicit API product controls and future submit/status/result lifecycle.

runtime_decision_matrix.fit: No repository evidence currently requires a long-lived container, custom connection lifecycle, or server process.
runtime_decision_matrix.tradeoffs: Would add standing compute and operational surface before a concrete workload requirement exists.

runtime_decision_matrix.fit: Phase 14 retained AgentCore as an optional experiment target rather than the default runtime.
runtime_decision_matrix.tradeoffs: Using it for Phase 19 solely for productization or certification breadth would violate the evidence-first service-selection rule.

threat_controls.malformed_json: Strict UTF-8 JSON object admission, duplicate-key and unknown-field rejection.
threat_controls.repository_url_abuse: Only canonical HTTPS github.com owner/repository coordinates are admitted.
threat_controls.ssrf_style_source_redirection: User URL is never used as a fetch target; the adapter calls fixed api.github.com endpoints and does not follow redirects.
threat_controls.repository_enumeration: Public GitHub only; public ingress identity/rate policy remains to be selected and measured.
threat_controls.large_repository_amplification: Only exact-commit uv.lock is read in the v1 repository evidence path; no clone/build/tree crawl.
threat_controls.dependency_explosion: uv.lock package records are bounded at 5000; repository scan candidate evaluations are bounded at 100000.
threat_controls.github_api_abuse: Fixed success-path provider-call shape and no adapter retry; public rate/backpressure layer remains unimplemented.
threat_controls.prompt_injection_from_repository_content: Repository contents do not become planner instruction authority; only bounded metadata enters public semantic planning.
threat_controls.retrieval_poisoning: Knowledge retrieval requires admitted source provenance and content identity; retrieved content remains evidence, not instruction authority.
threat_controls.model_amplification: Existing model output limits are retained, but per-public-analysis model-call count is UNMEASURED and must be frozen before deploy.
threat_controls.athena_scan_amplification: Retained Athena workgroup cutoff is 10485760 bytes/query; per-public-analysis query count remains UNMEASURED.
threat_controls.bedrock_token_amplification: Retained synthesis max output is 2048 tokens and context is bounded; aggregate public token budget remains UNMEASURED.
threat_controls.retry_amplification: GitHub adapter has zero automatic adapter retries; aggregate SDK/queue/public retry budget remains unmeasured.
threat_controls.concurrency_exhaustion: No public concurrency is authorized yet; future ingress/worker concurrency must be an explicit configured limit.
threat_controls.cost_denial_of_wallet: No public runtime is deployed until per-request resource dimensions and global admission controls are measurable and independently enforceable.
threat_controls.result_tampering: Future result must be deterministically admitted and bound to request, snapshot, evidence, workload version, and result identity before exposure.
threat_controls.identity_replay: Request content identity exists; replay/idempotency must additionally bind the immutable resolved snapshot and workload version.
threat_controls.telemetry_data_leakage: Retain Phase 17 content minimization; emit identifiers/counts/durations/outcomes rather than raw request, source, prompt, or response content.

observability_contract.rule: Telemetry content is minimized and is never business/evidence authority.

aws_documented_facts_reviewed_2026_09_10: API Gateway HTTP API maximum integration timeout: 30 seconds, not increaseable.
API Gateway Regional REST integration timeout can exceed 29 seconds with quota implications.
Lambda reserved concurrency caps function concurrency; setting reserved concurrency to zero intentionally stops function processing.
Lambda function URL auth types: AWS_IAM or NONE.
SQS standard delivery is at least once; duplicate delivery must be tolerated.
Athena workgroups support BytesScannedCutoffPerQuery with a 10000000-byte minimum value.
Athena SQL on-demand pricing is driven by data scanned, with a 10 MB minimum per query in the documented pricing model.
Knowledge Base retrieval uses the Retrieve API and bedrock:Retrieve permission.
API Gateway REST usage-plan throttling/quotas are best effort and must not be the sole cost-control boundary.

gate19_2_minimum_experiment.goal: Build or invoke a representative non-public public-analysis runner that composes the retained repository, deterministic finding/risk, structured/semantic evidence, synthesis, and result-admission stages; measure stage and end-to-end latency/call counts at bounded representative inputs before choosing SYNC or ASYNC.
gate19_2_minimum_experiment.decision_rule: Select SYNC only if the complete representative workload is composed, bounded, retry-safe, and comfortably fits a chosen synchronous ingress timeout at measured upper-bound/p95 conditions. Select ASYNC if latency variability, backpressure, isolation, or timeout evidence makes synchronous coupling unsafe. Otherwise remain DEFERRED_PENDING_MEASUREMENT.
